sources.locator: Specifications: total 150 mm, both blades 45 by 9 mm, round handle 60 mm by diameter 3.5 mm; 304 stainless steel.
Exact-SKU photograph; angular and rounded flat blades, continuous polished round stem.
Dry, non-sterile, 45% polyester / 55% cellulose; 300 wipes per double-bagged pack, ten packs per case; lubricants among listed applications.
US-TDS-003 Rev.4/23. PDF page 2 product table; page 3 applications; page 4 typical basis weight 69 g/m2. Inspected original table, not only search extract.
Transparent rectangular pouch, top tear region, white wipes and blue/black text.
Manufacturer lists steel can, 23 L nominal capacity and oil-soaked cloth use. Existing source-linked asset reused.
sources.retrieval: Web document inspected; no binary hash claimed.

wipes.size_basis: 9 inches converted exactly; 23 cm is the rounded alternate catalogue notation, not a manufacturing tolerance.

reconstruction.packing_count: Select one 300-wipe pack, not one ten-pack shipping case.
